history.title: History
paragraphs: VKS Sharanya Welfare society is a humble initiative of Ms Veena Prakash  and Mr Kartik Singh, both from a very simple ordinary family who always cherished a better dream, not only for themselves but for the immediate surroundings, who dream to share happiness around and give to others what ever best they can in their reach.

VKS Sharanya Welfare Society, registered under Govt of Andhra Pradesh societies act on 28th August 2012. (  Certifications  -80G, 12 A, FCRA ,CSR1, Skill India Training Partner and Posh Empanelled in WCD)
The prime purpose of the organisation is to render support with the help of Individuals/ Corporate/ Govt  agencies to reach out to the needy.

education.title: Education
paragraphs: We are focusing on conducting theatre programmes and extra circular activities in schools to imbibe personality development in children.
Every child participates in the programmes and we ensure that the bridge between the parents / teachers and children disappears.

In rural and semi urban areas, there is lot of scope of organising such programmes and also setting up a primary school . We are looking forward to plan for setting up schools in semi urban and rural places.

However in established schools we meet the principals and seek to promote theatre for children. And in primary schools and high schools we take orders for stitching school bags, make jute pencil boxes, tiffin bags and dresses which helps our SHG team in employment and thereby establish a social connectivity with schools to help rural women.

We appeal the authorities to provide us space for exhibiting eco friendly jute bags, pencil box, terracotta jewellery , handloom bags for the school children. This will encourage the children in using eco friendly products and thereby support the society.
Our team conducts employability skills training to the final year students in colleges.

In most of the government colleges students are deprived for special training as given in private colleges for the final year students to appear interviews. We have a team of trainers who have been training in colleges of Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh for employability skill training.

A CSR activity in colleges is organised by us where, We appeal the authorities to provide us two days space for putting up our stall for show casing terracotta ethnic jewellery, handloom cloths, sarees, silk hand made embroidery dupattas and stalls.
Participating for providing the space helps the team in selling products and also thereby helping our team for buying our raw material and resources for making products.
We motivate colleges students in participating and organising blood donation camps there by providing blood donation to cancer hospital.

health_care.title: Health Care
paragraphs: VKS sharanya welfare society Health Camp is one such special initiative to provide healthcare services to meet the immediate health care needs of the marginalized community in remote rural areas and slums through standalone camps. Customized health camps are organized extensively across the country offering comprehensive health services which are, preventive health camps, eye check up and gynaecological check up camps to a large number of people in selected intervention areas.

Multi-disciplinary projects include gynaecological, paediatric, ophthalmology, Blood Donation camps services etc. Duration of Sharanya Health Camps vary between one day and two days days with frequencies ranging between a month and a year.
The uniqueness of the model lies in its comprehensive approach where health promotion and prevention are given equal importance while curative care is administered.
Many organizations and institutions like Dr Dy Patil Hospital and Tata Cancer Hospital have associated with VKS Sharanya Society to conduct Health Camps successfully.from 2012 onwards.
Community health awareness programmes being conducted to help provide the community with health camps with free medicines.
HIV/AIDS being the highest threat of the entire globe we are concentrating on prevention of the spread of this pandemic. Especially women and youth are most vulnerable to HIV/AID, infection.

We are educating them in the ways it will spread , the measures like sterilization of injection, needles, blood safety and condom usage to be taken to prevent the spread of this epidemic. We have been conducting awareness camps in Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal by inviting resource person to address the participants in colleges/ Semi Urban and Rural areas and Slum areas.

water_sanitation.title: Water and Sanitation
paragraphs: Our objective was focusing on reaching primary school teachers and parents for creating awareness on hygiene and importance of proper water usage.
Adequate drinking water, sanitation, and hygiene are all essential ingredients to ensure human health.
Awareness was created in certain areas of Mahbubnagar for improvement of water quality and sanitation. Also, street plays were performed to spread awareness.
Through this programme, our beneficiaries included 2000 families directly and 1000 families directly over a tenure of 12 months.
Our project locations included Dhule in Maharashtra and Mahbubnagar in Telangana.
- Project Intervention - Provide safe drinking water to the community
- Project Duration - 2 years
- Project Location - Pune, Maharashtra
headers: Currently, VKS is collaborating with SGS for a CSR intervention project on safe drinking water provision.

disaster_response.title: Disaster Response
paragraphs: VKS Sharanya Team is spread in Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, UP, HP, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat. During natural disaster in the country we support the local NGOs working in the disaster areas by helping them in Medicinal aid, Cloths and Food distribution.
We provide help in kind which we gather from individuals and corporate at the areas effected by disaster.

special_support.title: Special Support Programme
paragraphs: To provide necessary educational materials support to poor and needy children.
To provide school uniforms, books, bags, shoes to those children who’s parents are daily wage labourers.
This helps the children in continuing with their studies .
During festivals we provide gifts to orphan children and make them participate in events.
We also provide support in kind to old age home in Sanpada Navi Mumbai.

women_empowerment.title: Women Empowerment
paragraphs: The major objective is to empower women to be be self dependent. We provide sewing machines at 2 villages in West Bengal and One Village in Sirohi and help women to utilize their time in stitching and embroidery work, Katha Stich and block print on sarees and Dupattas.
Help them in jute products making and market the same . Revenue generated is used for purchasing the raw material and also for the team minimal compensation per month.
